rules.title: GitHub token candidate
rules.description: A provider-shaped GitHub token candidate is present. This advisory pattern match does not establish that the credential is valid or active.
rules.remediation: Remove the credential from distributed content and history, rotate it if genuine, and use a secret manager or runtime environment reference.

rules.title: AWS access key identifier candidate
rules.description: An AWS access key identifier shape is present. An identifier alone is not a complete credential and this advisory match does not establish validity.
rules.remediation: Remove genuine access key identifiers from distributed content, investigate companion credentials, and rotate exposed credentials using short-lived roles where possible.

rules.title: Private key marker
rules.description: A private key opening marker is present. This advisory match does not parse the key or establish that key material is complete or usable.
rules.remediation: Remove private key material from distributed content and history; revoke or rotate a genuine exposed key and store its replacement outside the skill.

rules.title: Literal credential assignment candidate
rules.description: A credential-named assignment contains a non-placeholder quoted literal. This advisory heuristic does not establish that the value is a real secret.
rules.remediation: Replace credential literals with secret-manager or runtime references, use clearly non-secret placeholders in examples, and rotate genuine exposed credentials.

rules.title: Credential-bearing database connection candidate
rules.description: A database URI contains a literal username and password candidate. This advisory match does not connect to the database or validate credentials.
rules.remediation: Remove embedded database credentials, use runtime secret injection, and rotate genuine credentials that were exposed.

rules.title: System instruction disclosure request
rules.description: Text requests disclosure of system or developer instructions. This advisory language pattern is not proof of prompt injection or malicious intent.
rules.remediation: Remove disclosure requests from operational instructions and keep untrusted skill content subordinate to system and developer instructions.

rules.title: Environment exfiltration instruction
rules.description: Text requests sending environment data to a remote destination. This advisory language pattern does not establish that any data was transmitted.
rules.remediation: Remove requests to transmit environment data; allow only explicitly approved, minimal, non-secret diagnostic fields and destinations.

rules.title: Permission or safety bypass instruction
rules.description: Text requests bypassing permission, approval, or safety controls. This advisory language pattern is not proof of a successful bypass.
rules.remediation: Preserve permission and approval checks, use least privilege, and require explicit user approval for sensitive operations.

rules.title: Action concealment instruction
rules.description: Text requests concealing actions from the user or operator. This advisory language pattern does not establish deceptive behavior.
rules.remediation: Remove concealment instructions and disclose sensitive actions, approvals, and results to the user with appropriate auditability.

rules.title: Remote download piped to a shell
rules.description: A download command is piped directly to a shell. This advisory syntax match does not execute the command or establish the safety of its source.
rules.remediation: Download without execution, inspect the artifact, verify a pinned digest or signature, and require explicit approval before running it.

rules.title: Broad destructive removal command
rules.description: A forced recursive removal command targets a root or home location. This advisory syntax match does not establish that the command would run or succeed.
rules.remediation: Remove broad deletion commands; constrain cleanup to an explicitly validated workspace and require confirmation and a recoverable backup.

rules.title: Encoded execution pattern
rules.description: Text combines base64 decoding with an execution primitive. This advisory syntax match neither decodes nor executes the payload.
rules.remediation: Replace encoded execution with inspectable source, verify provenance, and require explicit approval before execution.

rules.title: Unpinned package installation indicator
rules.description: A supported pip or npm install command names a dependency without an exact version pin. This offline reproducibility indicator makes no vulnerability or CVE claim.
rules.remediation: Pin reviewed dependency versions and use a committed lockfile with integrity verification where supported; review updates through the normal dependency workflow.

rules.title: Unpinned dependency declaration indicator
rules.description: A supported package.json or requirements declaration lacks a recognized exact version pin. This offline reproducibility indicator makes no vulnerability or CVE claim and does not resolve dependencies or lockfiles.
rules.remediation: Use reviewed exact dependency versions and committed lockfiles with integrity verification where supported. Review remote sources explicitly; local references are not assessed as vulnerabilities.
